what: fix461: THE UMPIRE AT THE WIRE - every opening order of main (recon-tog) + rejection (recon-rej) needs the umpire SAFE stamp (tools/umpire-stamp.py -> data/UMPIRE-VERDICT.json) with her running code exactly the code it judged (src/lib/desk/umpire-gate.ts, in memory, ~7 µs); the umpire runs in the background (desk start + ~3 s after any code change); exits/take-profits never blocked; the old request-book/rule-anchor lists stay report-only (option A).
